name: Niwot Ridge (default model)
description: Subalpine forest, 1998–2005, two climate steps per day, out-of-the-box SIPNET options. From the niwot smoke test.

name: Russell Ranch 1 (events)
description: Agricultural site near Russell Ranch, CA, 2016–2017, 3-hourly climate, with irrigation, planting, harvest and tillage events. From the russell_1 smoke test.

name: Russell Ranch 2 (nitrogen cycle)
description: As Russell Ranch 1, with the nitrogen cycle and litter pool enabled, plus fertilization events. From the russell_2 smoke test.

name: Russell Ranch 3 (growth resp., leaf water)
description: As Russell Ranch 1, with growth respiration, leaf water and litter pool on and water-limited heterotrophic respiration off. From the russell_3 smoke test.

name: Russell Ranch 4 (microbes)
description: As Russell Ranch 1, with microbes and soil-temperature phenology on; snow, GDD phenology and events off. From the russell_4 smoke test.
